report.notes: Root cause fixed: _STROKES is now built in canonical form (normalise() applied to every member, only single letters kept, module-level assert that every member is NFKC-stable and a letter). Members: one-stroke radicals 一丨丶丿乙亅 (incl. Kangxi U+2F00-2F05), stroke variants 乀乁乚乛, stroke-and-dot radicals 二亠, Hangul araea ᆞᆢ (ㆍ normalises to ᆞ), 〆. Dropped the dead CJK Strokes range U+31C0-31E3 and the non-letters ・/〇, which already act as gap. Unlike the diagnosis, not all 214 Kangxi radicals were added: their normalised forms include real words (人, 口, 山), so '山口 is' would become a false-positive link, against D17's owner rule that real short foreign words are names. Kangxi-spelled real-word radicals are identical to ordinary text once normalised, so they fall under that already-accepted residual. The test checks all 400 two-letter stroke pairs (ordinary and Kangxi forms) via has_link_or_contact and mask_links, and the reviewer's forms plus 二丶 and 亠丶 through verify, extractive, build_surface and require_valid, with readable controls and the owner residuals. On da10d0b8: 289 failed, 141 passed (pairs already caught and controls). After the fix: 430 passed. tests/web and tests/assist: 3941 passed.
